product_metadata.title: Organize It All 9 Pair Floor Shoe Rack | Storage and Organization | Great For Bedroom | Entryway | Closet | Compact Design | Black
features: 9 PAIR SHOES: This shoe rack has 18 shoe pegs. It can hold up to 9 pairs of shoes.
ORGANIZATION: The shoe rack is perfect for organizing and storing your shoes in your closet, bedroom, or entryway. The compact size doesn’t take up a lot of space so it can be used almost anywhere.
DURABLE: Made of metal tube grid and a plastic frame, this shoe rack is durable and lightweight. Easy to assemble and move around.
description: The compact design of the Organize It All 9 Pair Floor Shoe Rack is perfect to fit in any location needed. Use in the bedroom or dorm room to keep your shoes organized so they take up less space. The design is simple and modern and goes with any home décor. Tuck away in the closet or keep in the entry to create a new storage space in your home.
